restraints_config._comment: rgi_utils restraint-guided inference (distance + ligand conformer). RUN: protenix pred -i restr_example.json -o out --use_default_params true --use_msa false --seeds 0 --step 200 --sample 1 --cycle 4 . Keys: gpu->torch (or backend:jax/numpy); method=CG; max_iter per step. start_sigma: a restraint is ACTIVE only when sigma<=start_sigma; settable globally (here), per distance entry, and once for all conformer terms (3 levels; per-entry overrides global). ('_comment' keys are ignored by the parser.)

distance_restraints_config._comment: COM distance between two atom groups, pulled to target_distance. type options: harmonic{target_distance} | flat-bottomed{target_distance1,target_distance2} | flat-bottomed1{target_distance1} | flat-bottomed2{target_distance2}. Selection DSL: chain/resid N/resid A to B/index/and/or/not/(). resid = per-chain 1-based ordinal; QUALIFY protein groups with 'chain A and (...)' so a bare resid range does not also match the ligand (chain B) atoms.
distance_restraints_config.atom_selection1: chain A and ((resid 5 to 84) or (resid 186 to 224))

conformer_restraints_config._comment: Hold the ligand at its ideal RDKit geometry (bond/angle/chiral + intramolecular VdW). start_sigma here applies to ALL conformer terms (one value, all ligands); lower it (e.g. 1.0) to enforce ligand geometry only late in denoising.
